title: Panel With One-Way Design Is Too Large for Front Door
text:
Panel With One-Way Design Is Too Large for Front Door. I love this DII HAPPY HALLOWEEN LACE SPIDER WEB WINDOW OR DOOR PANEL DECORATION (1 Panel, 38" x 84"), but it's far too wide and long to hang on my front door. It's also too long to hang on the curtain rod over my sliding patio doors. Be sure to measure the area where you plan to install this!

I think that the panel will work as a table runner for a large table (over a solid-color tablecloth). However, the design woven into the lace is a one-way design, with "Happy Halloween" at the top left, and a flying ghost at the lower right. Because of the design, I can't think of any way to partially fold (or cut down) this panel to make it fit onto a small table or standard door.

I haven't washed my panel, but I doubt that it will shrink the many inches required (both vertically and horizontally) to make it fit my front door. This panel is probably too delicate to hang outdoors, exposed to the elements, on the side of my house. The care instructions say: "Machine wash cold on gentle cycle, use mild detergent, wash dark colors separately, do not bleach, tumble dry on low setting, press with warm iron as needed."

Because this charming Halloween panel is too large to use as a door decoration on a standard-sized door, I rate it at 3 stars ("It's okay" on the official Amazon scale).

UPDATE: After washing in warm water, the panel shrank, but not enough to fit my front door. It's still 3" too wide, and 8" too long. I guess that the panel would work to decorate an open doorway, if the extra length is folded down at the top or up at the bottom.
